column1: # catalog_taxonomy.tsv - machine taxonomy of all closed symmetry groups, N = 3..14
# (N=14 rows from the orbit-partition decomposition catalogue materials/14Spins.txt,
#  which uses the IR canonical representative; see code/catalog_format.cpp).
# id      = N/o<order>.<index>; <index> is the 1-based line position inside the
#           "--- order K ---" section of the anchor catalogue file:
#           NOTE: regenerating a catalogue may permute lines inside a section
#           (parallel enumeration), so the committed files are the ID anchors.
# order   = |Aut| (recomputed independently; matches every section header)
# twins   = magnetic composite sizes n_g (identical rows off the mutual edge)
# orbits  = vertex orbit sizes under the full Aut
# fixedpt = y: has a fixed vertex (entry inherited from level N-1 by the tower
#           theorem); n: fixed-point-free (essentially new at this N).
# cyclic  = y iff an element of order |Aut| exists
# maxelt  = maximal element order in Aut
# abelian, ambivalent = y/n, computed when |Aut| <= 2000, else '-'
#           (ambivalent: every element conjugate to its inverse <=> all
#            characters real <=> X-approximation blocks combine pairwise)
